body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 is **DELETED**. Current tree: ~58 files / ~12,500 LOC.

## Pitch
Three z-levels (sky / surface / basement) in ONE RimWorld `Map`. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky, (2) performance, (3) full vanilla parity.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE

One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`; bands along **+z**; permanently-fogged gutter between bands; `Slot = ceil((bandHeight+2)/64)×64` — **64-alignment is load-bearing**. Map sizes curated (126 / 190 / 254).

### The one insight
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum; `Reachability.CanReach` works **unpatched** — we patch nothing in `Reachability`/`PathFinder`/region traversal.

### Dividing line
Graph/logic = FREE. Geometry/presentation = NOT free; fix per draw/compute site. Reachability-as-proxy consumers (wander roots fixed; joy/meditation/pens un-audited).

### Hard 1.6 constraints
Jobified pathfinder · no `PathFinder.FindPath` · `BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on unwalkable cells.

### Generation-window rules
Carve in `GenerateContentsIntoMap` postfix · `TryPendingSurfaceRect` for genstep-time band math · start-spot clamp + `RescueStrandedColonists` + `CarveStartClearing` on zero-standable surfaces (also fires on ocean tiles; "solid rock" wording is a mislabel).

# 2. ⚠ THE LOAD BOUNDARY (root-caused, fix pending verification)
Cache poisoning: `ConstructComponents()` creates a transient EMPTY `ABBandMap` that mid-load rendering latches. Fix: `CompOf` never caches while `Scribe.mode != Inactive` + `FinalizeInit` rebinds all caches. Also: uniqueID-keyed statics → CWT; load camera move deferred. **Verify: menu-load · load-while-playing · double cycle.**

# 3. PER-BAND BIOME / CAVERNS — verified
`GetBiomeAt` prefix (cell param) · sky biome locked to surface · Biomes! Caverns basements. Watch: perf-mod biome caching (`biome report` MISMATCH) · stalagmite leak · Earthen Depths temp.

# 4. CAMERA — verified. `viewBand` · `CurrentViewRect` clip · `ABBandCurtain` = `MapEdgeMaterial` at WorldClipper altitude.

# 5. MAP GEN — ~4× faster, closed (crowdedness mechanism; doomed-band plant skip).

# 6. RUNTIME PERF — 59.6 fps @96 pawns, mod ≈2% frame. All visual work is bake-time section-mesh geometry.

# 7. SKY SYNC / BELOW-DRAW / BORDER STACK
Event-driven sky sync; below-draw prints + translates (one big map, no DrawPos lies).
**Border stack (verified clean in runs #133-134, visual verdict pending):** shared `ABNineFan` · below fog = vanilla corner smoothing sampled one band down · below edge shadows = vanilla EdgeShadows via shared `ABEdgeShadowGeometry` (ONE copy, three callers) · meadow fade = meadow terrain's own material as 9-vert fan over the mass cell, `IsMeadowGround` property-based (Soil/Gravel/AB_RoofSurface, else non-Hard && (natural || fertility>0), water excluded) · rooftop fade via TerrainHard→TerrainFadeRough shader-swapped clone + AlphaAddTex (**shader assignment resets renderQueue — set queue after**) · drop-off EdgeShadow ring at open-air cells bordering mass.

# 8. SKY-MASS UNIFICATION v2 (2026-07-29 — suppress-and-field; v1 cover REVERTED)
**v1 cover (paint atlas tiles above cutout+fog) was a shipped regression:** queue-above-everything erased every overhanging sprite (tree tops, plants) and large interiors rendered as the near-flat mask-15 slab — the run-25 lesson at scale. Lesson saved to user lore.
**v2 — concealment by NOT drawing, sprite-safe by construction (all our geometry ≤ lowQueue+2+spread ≪ cutout):**
- **Field underlay** (`SectionLayer_ABMountainCap`): EVERY mass cell gets the rock's `naturalTerrain` (rough stone) material — world-position sampled, genuinely textured, BM-recolor-live — as uv-FREE quads (`AddTerrainQuad`; terrain materials get their own submeshes so uv-free and uv-carrying geometry never share a mesh) at `lowQueue`. Edge tiles (atlas lip toward unlinked sides) only when mask≠15, at `lowQueue+1`, + corner fillers; interior = field alone. Plain rock types from ITS OWN def; ore types from ground (seamless surround). **Visible ore prints natively over the field** (prospecting); fogged things never print (vanilla rule) — no leak. relevantChangeTypes += FogOfWar.
- **Wall-sprite suppression** (`Patch_Thing_Print_ABSkyMassRock`): prefix on `Thing.Print` (single choke point — Mineable doesn't override) returns false for sky-band plain natural rock. Mining/selection/designations/link-masks untouched; below-layer prints unaffected (band check).
- **Fog scope** (`Patch_SectionLayer_FogOfWar_ABSkyMassScope`): prefix-replaced Regenerate recomputes vanilla's 9-vert colors with one predicate change — fogged && sky-mass counts as clear. Fog DATA untouched; gutter/other bands byte-identical; used `FogGrid.IsFogged` not `FogGrid_Unsafe` (no Unity.Collections ref needed).
- **Shadow scope** (`ABSkyMassShadowScope`, kept from v1): EdgeShadows + internal SunShadows prefix-replaced on banded maps; sky-mass rock casts nothing INTO the mass; silhouette shadows kept; vanilla-identical elsewhere; exception → vanilla fallback. `MassCell` gutter-guarded.
Result: mass = one textured rough-stone field, silhouette-only atlas lips, no fog hole, ore blobs visible, plants/pawns/sprites untouched.

# 9. VERTICAL LINKS — elevator SHIPPED (untested). Full-mesh 2×2 `AB2_Elevator`; shaft collapse; legacy-save migration. Known: `Carry` latent hole.

# 10. BETTER MOUNTAINS COMPAT — code-complete, co-load test deferred. Variant mode (silhouette-only sprites now) + live-graphic caches + live `ABMinedRockLookup` color + field uses BM-rebuilt naturalTerrain graphics live.

# 11. DIAGNOSTICS
band info · transit health · below pawn report · stuck probe · watchdog (verdict-contradiction unfixed) · transit logging · below layer report · lighting report · bisect toggles · biome report · shader report · ABGenProfile · cap corner filler toggle.

# 12. OPEN WORK
1. **Verify unification v2**: plants/trees back everywhere (the regression) · mass = textured rough-stone field, no flat slab · no internal lips/rims · no fog hole on the mass (fog normal elsewhere — check surface + basement + band edges) · ore blobs visible; mining a fogged vein reveals ore correctly (FogOfWar regen) · silhouette lips + drop ring + fades (meadow/rough/roof) · surface-band shadows vanilla.
2. **Verify reload fix** (menu-load, load-while-playing, double cycle).
3. **Verify elevator**.
4. **COMBAT** — never verified.
5. **WATERFALLS — stored.** Rule: upper-band water adjacent to `ShowsBelow` ⇒ south-face animated strip + mist + sustainer; scope (a) full/(b) renderer-only/(c) later.
6. Mountain sun-shadow onto surface (parked) · vertical conduit · DrawDynamicThings isolation · compat audit · transplant · reachability-proxy audit.

# 13. LESSONS (telegraphic)
Measure, don't reason · crowdedness drives destroy cost · reuse the engine's object · fog softness lives in EXPLORED neighbours' fans · classify terrain by PROPERTY not def identity · **conceal by NOT drawing (print suppression + fog-color re-predicate) + low-queue field — NEVER a queue-above-cutout cover: it clips every overhanging sprite and mask-15 is near-flat (run-25, relearned as a shipped regression)** · to replace a vanilla SectionLayer's output, prefix-return-false Regenerate and re-emit filtered; extract verbatim geometry ONCE · statics keyed by game-scoped ids leak — CWT · never cache comps while Scribe active · FinalizeInit = worker thread · altitude ≠ draw order but IS the cutout depth tiebreaker · material.shader assignment resets renderQueue · green build proves nothing about reflectively-instantiated classes · build-once caches go stale under settings-reapplying mods.

# 14. PUBLISHING
Store page honest (update after verification). known-issues.json v2 (no-elevator + hard-fog-squares entries stale). Live item **3773267907**.

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true`. Companions: `astryl.Circinus` + `astryl.ModernDevTools` + `BiomesTeam.BiomesCaverns` + `BiomesTeam.CoreFramework` (+ BM only for compat runs). New colony for banding; reload tests need load-while-playing. Transit logging + watchdog reset every launch.
